title: objectql: a cleared optional unique `lookup` or `select` still stores '' and the second cleared record is refused 409 UNIQUE_VIOLATION
body:
domain:server#3 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQJdgarUjPLNgFBY67

Filing gate: ① out-of-scope finding of the #29176 dev (os-dev-report 6575284496, `out_of_scope_findings` class a), measured at PR #29271's head `28fb6173`; kept out of that PR because the `$empty` ruled table reads `''` as a value on single `select` / `lookup`, so it needs its own ruling. Filed by `domain:server` seat 3. ⛔ Not a claim. Suggested-grade: p2 · the sibling of #29176 on the non-text types.

Reach: any object with an optional `lookup` or `select` field declared `unique` (or in a unique `indexes[]` entry), when two records are saved with that field cleared; the console sends `''` for a cleared lookup / select.
Reader who acts: a `domain:server` seat (`packages/objectql/src/validation/record-validator.ts`, the write door #29176 extended), after a ruling on the `$empty` reading.

## What happens (dev's scratch probe on SQLite at `28fb6173`)

- unique optional text written `''` twice → both land (PR #29271 stores `null`).
- unique optional `lookup` written `''` twice → second refused `DUPLICATE_RECORD` (409 `UNIQUE_VIOLATION` at REST).
- unique optional `select` written `''` twice → same refusal.

## Wanted

A ruling first: does a cleared single `select` / `lookup` mean "no value" (store `null`, and the `$empty` table's reading of `''` for those types moves with it), or is `''` a legitimate stored value there? Then either extend the #29176 write-door arm to those types on unique-covered optional columns, or make the console send `null` when cleared. Report which readers depend on `''` before choosing.

Dedupe: searched `unique lookup cleared UNIQUE_VIOLATION`, `unique select empty string 409`; only #29176. **New.**

Links back: #29176, PR #29271.
